newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese bonds end higher after rate cut.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese bonds end higher after rate cut.

text.p: Portuguese bonds ended firmer after the central bank cut key rates and were indifferent to a drop in the dollar as spreads against 10-year Bunds hit an all-time low of 80 basis points, dealers said.
"Futures and cash closed higher, helped by the Bank of Portugal and somewhat indifferent to the drop in the dollar," a dealer said.
"June 1997 closed above the previous strong resistance level of 108.50, but we'll have to see on Monday whether there will be support above this level," he added.
Dealers said they expected shorter bonds to be well-supported on Monday.
